# Quillframe — machine-oriented project guide

Quillframe is an AI-native long-form fiction framework and authoring environment. It is not an LLM chat wrapper and does not delegate runtime authority to a model provider or third-party coding-agent product.

## Product model

Host agent -> Quillframe novel contract -> Model API / tools

The host owns generic sessions, model/tool loops, sandbox, and subagent lifecycle. Quillframe governs Project resolution, Story/Character/Relationship state, Canon boundaries, bounded Context, candidate/review/release contracts, quality gates, learning evidence, SQLite persistence, checkpoints, receipts, and authorized Settlement. Its embedded Agent Runtime is an optional/reference implementation. Models perform inference; they do not own authority.

Ordinary model-service setup is exactly:

- API Endpoint
- Access Token

Provider identity is diagnostic provenance, not runtime authority or a required onboarding field. Resolved access-token values must not enter prompts, Context, SQLite, checkpoints, receipts, fingerprints, or client bundles.

## Durable state and authority

Canonical durable product state is SQLite-native. The UI does not directly read or write SQLite; the intended boundary is SolidJS/Tauri host -> typed Bridge/API -> Python Core -> SQLite.

Keep these distinctions explicit:

- stored != injected
- Plan != Canon
- Review != Accepted
- Accepted != Settled
- autosave != Accepted
- revision != Canon
- Research != Character Knowledge
- Corpus != Canon
- session != Canon
- persistence != authority

Settlement is an authorized before->after state transition with current-state validation and post-condition checks. A partial or mismatched write is not silently promoted to success.

## Agent-facing integration

A portable Quillframe Agent Skill exists at:
https://github.com/xiaooye/cn_webnovel_agent/blob/main/agent-skills/quillframe/SKILL.md

It is intentionally read-only. It can inspect safe Host Bridge projections but must not manufacture write authority, accept prose, settle Canon, expose host-private paths, or reinterpret READY/preflight states as permission to mutate runtime state.

Machine-readable skill index:
https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

Quillframe public discovery catalog:
https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json

## Public web surface

The product website and hosted Studio are discovery/authoring surfaces. They are not a public Quillframe Core API and do not advertise an A2A server, MCP server, OAuth resource server, payment protocol, or hosted model gateway unless a future version explicitly publishes those contracts.

Do not send model access tokens, private manuscripts, project databases, or other secrets to public issue trackers or arbitrary web endpoints.
